package pages

export component Badge(label: string): html {
<head>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/shared.css" />
<style>.badge { color: red }</style>
</head>
<span class="badge">{label}</span>
}

export component Note(text: string): html {
<head>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/shared.css" />
<style>.note { color: blue }</style>
</head>
<p class="note">{text}</p>
}

export component Panel(label: string, text: string): html {
<div><Badge label={label} /><Note text={text} /></div>
}

export component Document(label: string, text: string, children: html): html {
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
  <head><title>t</title></head>
  <body><slot required /></body>
</html>
}
